claims: The reconstructed fr2_mfile_release preserves 32-bit wrapping decrement; it stores -1 and signals the recorded semaphore only on zero, preserving the signed counter result or SignalSema result.

The reconstructed fr2_dma_copy preserves the measured guard, 16-byte target descriptor, FlushCache(0), one DMA submission and polling until negative; it returns the input positive count without claiming DMA success.
